dedupe_keys.name: saudi domestic consumption natural gas and natural gas liquids

description: Saudi Domestic Consumption Natural Gas And Natural Gas Liquids is a dataset listed in KAPSARC Data Portal, an energy economics open data portal, published or maintained by King Abdullah Petroleum Studies and Research Center (KAPSARC). This dataset contains Saudi Domestic Consumption Natural Gas And Natural Gas Liquids for 2021. Data from Saudi Central Bank (SAMA). Follow datasource.kapsarc.org and it’s APIs to stay in sync and advance energy economics research. Natural Gas Liquids.(Thousand Barrels) Natural Gas Includes Methane and Ethane, Quantity is in Thousand Barrels of Oil Equivalent. Coverage: as titled: Saudi Arabia, the Gulf states, India or the world (see the dataset page). The portal flags it as a time series. The portal files it under Conventional Fuels. Its keywords are Domestic, Consumption. The portal shows 2026-09-15 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Public Domain. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy, water and transport system studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kapsarc-open-data-portal.
